question: Approve the ideation direction: widen the dispatch build-count bar to tolerate exactly one corrective rebuild?

artifacts.summary: Retained streams answered the decisive question: the claude 2/2 was a corrected rebuild (--stamp then --bare-mode, one durable stamp), the codex 2/1 an error-then-retry. Both are benign self-correction, so the exact 1/1 count reddens good conduct. Decision: tolerate one corrective rebuild; identical rebuilds, three-plus attempts, and final failures stay red. Spiked 7/7 correct against real command.log bytes plus six controls. Net +30 across 1 file.
